derivation: by simpa [inverseImageMap, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] using (Adjunction.homEquiv_unit (adj := TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction CommRingCat.{u} f.hom.base) (X := Y.sheaf) (Y := X.sheaf) (f := inverseImageMap f))
explanation: The adjunction identity identifies the unit followed by the right-adjoint map of the mate with the adjunction hom-equivalence applied to that mate. Unfolding `inverseImageMap` reduces this to the sheaf hom-equivalence round trip, and taking the underlying map's component gives the stated section equality. The current proof instead uses the library's `inverseImageMap_unit_hom` theorem.
